description:
Permanently delete an offer by UUID.

WARNING: This action is irreversible. The offer will be removed from the database entirely.
Consider using update_offer with status: "archived" instead if you want to hide the offer without deleting it.

Returns { status: "deleted", offer_id: "<uuid>" } on success.
Returns error with code "NOT_FOUND" if the offer doesn't exist.

This permanently removes the offer. Prefer update_offer with status archived to hide without deleting.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true to confirm deletion. Omitted or false is rejected.

id.description: UUID of the offer to permanently delete. Get from search_offers results.

name: delete_offer
title: Delete Offer
